deficiencies.description: The rewrite converts the lecturer's pointing gestures indicating the location of the tumour and the outer surface of the uterus into a spatial description stating that the tumour lies next to the outer surface.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: You can see that the tumor is here. This is the outer surface of the uterus.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: The tumour lies next to the outer surface of the uterus
deficiencies.studentHarm: The student learns that the fibroid specifically lies next to the outer surface of the uterus, a anatomical relationship not specified by the lecturer.

considerations.sourcePassage: So you can see again that this is actually circumspect and very separate from the surrounding stroma and the surrounding tissue.
considerations.reason: The lecturer used 'circumspect' as an apparent slip of the tongue for 'circumscribed'. Changing it to the conventional pathological term 'circumscribed' does not harm student learning.
